description: Fix 4 pre-existing test failures in the backend test suite
steps: Fix test_middleware_adds_security_headers: The unified_middleware in apps/backend/app/main.py adds X-Request-ID and X-API-Version but is missing the security headers the test expects (X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=...). Add these three security headers to the response in the unified_middleware function, after the line that sets X-API-Version.

Fix test_render_chapter_not_found: The test calls /api/v1/content/render/SEBA/10/science/chemical-reactions with 'SEBA' in uppercase, but _validate_path_params in apps/backend/app/api/v1/content.py uses SAFE_PATH_RE = re.compile(r'^[a-z0-9-]+$') which rejects uppercase. The test patches KnowledgeObject.find_one to return None expecting a 404, but validation fails first with 400. Fix the source code: update SAFE_PATH_RE to also allow uppercase letters: r'^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'. Board names like 'SEBA' and 'CBSE' are naturally uppercase.

Fix test_duplicate_event_returns_duplicate: The test mocks redis.get to return '1' to simulate a duplicate, but the source code in apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py checks 'if existing == "completed"' or 'if existing.startswith("processing:")'. The value '1' matches neither condition, so processing continues and 'user_not_found' is returned. The fix should be in the source code: the idempotency check should treat ANY non-None value from redis.get as meaning the event was already seen. Change the logic: if 'existing' is truthy (not None), return {status: 'duplicate'} immediately, unless it's a stale processing entry (processing for > 5 min which means previous attempt crashed). Specifically: after getting 'existing' from redis, if existing == 'completed' return {status: 'duplicate'}. If existing starts with 'processing:' check timestamp - if fresh return {status: 'duplicate'}, if stale allow reprocessing. For any other truthy value (legacy entries like '1'), return {status: 'duplicate'}.

Fix test_get_endpoints_no_500: The /api/v1/content/library-bundle and /api/content/library-bundle endpoints in apps/backend/app/api/v1/public_content.py call Beanie document methods (Board.find, Class.find, etc.) which throw exceptions when MongoDB is not initialized. Add a try/except around the database calls in get_library_bundle that catches exceptions and returns an empty {boards: []} response with appropriate error logging, similar to the graceful fallback pattern already used in the seo sitemap endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Full test suite (python -m pytest tests/) shows no new failures
findings: The /api/v1/content/library-bundle endpoint was being matched by the content.py catch-all /{slug} route before the public_content.py /library-bundle route. Fixed by reordering router registration so public_content.router is included before content.router at the /api/v1/content prefix. All 191 tests pass.
